Siberia & Inner Asia / Tuva, southern Siberia

Tuvan traditions.

Sound, ritual specialists and a specific local repertoire.

PEOPLE & CONTEXT

A place, a name,
a living history.

Field research in Tuva examines the organization of sound and music within shamanic practice. The pathway follows that research without treating all Tuvan throat singing as a ritual or all ritual sound as the same phenomenon.

Ritual soundLocal repertoireField recordings
A WAY TO STUDY

Begin with the source.

Identify the performer, occasion and source of a publicly available recording. Describe audible features first and attribute explanations of their ritual role to the practitioner or researcher.
